title: 3-Hour Snorkeling Experience on SeaRay Sundeck 26' up to 8 guests
includes: Sounds system w/ Bluetooth to play your own music on board
Safety equipment: Lifejackets for adults, kids and infants, flares, fire extinguishers, etc.
Cooler with ice so you can bring your own beverages
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Looking for the ultimate way to experience Miami’s dazzling coastline? Legacy Boats offers a 3-hour private snorkeling adventure aboard a sleek 26' SeaRay Sundeck that blends luxury, fun, and discovery. Whether you're planning a getaway with friends or celebrating a special occasion, this trip is perfect for groups of 4, 6, or 8. With a seasoned captain at the helm, you’ll be guided to the most stunning snorkeling spots, where vibrant marine life and hidden coastal gems await. The boat is fully equipped with snorkeling gear, a premium sound system for your favorite tunes, and all the essentials—fuel, water, and ice included. Plus, it’s BYOB and food-friendly, so you can sip and snack while soaking in the sun. It’s not just a boat ride—it’s your front-row seat to Miami’s underwater magic.
